description: Sign in to Brightspace on this computer so the other tools work. Does nothing and says so if the saved session is already valid, so it is safe to call first when you are unsure. Opens a browser window for the user to sign in by hand when no password is saved (nothing to type means a windowless sign-in can only time out); otherwise it signs in in the background and reports the 2FA number for the user to approve on their phone. A window is for the user's own hands only (no saved password, or when the user asks to see one): after a "could not be reached", stuck, or timeout answer, call sign_in again without visible. Call this when a Brightspace tool failed because of authentication, or when the user asks to sign in or log in to Brightspace. Every answer says what to do next, including whether to call again.

visible.description: Open a browser window for the user to sign in by hand. Omit it: a window then opens by itself only when no password is saved on this computer, because a sign-in with no window has nothing to type into the school's form and would only time out. Pass true ONLY when the user asks for a window, or an error says a step needs the user's own hands (an unsupported sign-in, or no saved password). Do NOT pass true after a "could not be reached", stuck, or timeout failure: just call sign_in again, because the saved password is typed in the background and a window adds nothing. Pass false to insist on a background sign-in.

name: sign_in
title: Sign In to Brightspace
